_comment: Gilded collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed gilded-gold-leaf` after Ancient Ruins', then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_gilded.py, one thin module per look.

readme.title: Gilded
readme.summary: Pokemon made precious: gold leaf, kintsugi, filigree, rose gold, jewels and gold-veined marble.
looks: each line wears one look: gold leaf over red lacquer (Machop, Landorus, Meltan); kintsugi, its own colours as glazed ceramic with cracks mended in gold (Wobbuffet, Shellos, Binacle); black velvet with gold filigree scrollwork (Sableye, Mawile, Poochyena); polished rose gold set with tiny diamonds (Hoppip, Ponyta, Glimmet); gold studded with rubies, emeralds, sapphires and amethysts (Dratini, Starly, Tatsugiri); white marble veined with gold (Stantler, Farfetch'd, Skrelp)
polished metal shading; light glints and sparkles off the gold, runs along gold seams and veins, and the gems glow softly in the dark; gem-bright eyes
shiny: platinum and silver instead of gold, the gems turned round the colour wheel
